records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Labs!
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Your workspace for Orchard Labs is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project or key milestone despite two outreach emails (email:e143a394, email:d8729cd7) and zero customer replies. Only positive signal is one invite sent (slack:8d80be59). Silent Starter accounts with no project by day 6 usually stall; 8 days left leaves some chance.

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Nice to see you've already invited a teammate to the Orchard Labs workspace — that's a good first step.

The next one is creating a real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a live project is what makes the first week genuinely useful. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow along.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Nadia
